metadata.description: ISO/IEC 27701:2019 Privacy Information Management System (PIMS) controls mapped to Chilean Privacy Law (Ley 21.719) requirements

controls.title: Determination of PII
controls.description: The organization shall determine the PII that is processed and the purposes for which it is processed.

controls.title: Privacy by design and by default
controls.description: The organization shall implement privacy by design and by default principles.

controls.title: Legal basis for processing
controls.description: The organization shall determine and document the legal basis for processing PII.

controls.title: Legitimate interests pursued by the PII controller
controls.description: Where processing is based on legitimate interests, the organization shall document and maintain records of the legitimate interests.

controls.title: Consent and choice
controls.description: The organization shall provide mechanisms for PII principals to give, withdraw and manage consent.

controls.title: Purpose limitation
controls.description: The organization shall process PII only for the purposes specified at the time of collection or for purposes compatible with those originally specified.

controls.title: Collection of PII
controls.description: The organization shall collect only the PII that is necessary for the specified purposes.

controls.title: PII processing
controls.description: The organization shall process PII in accordance with applicable privacy requirements and only for the specified purposes.

controls.title: Retention of PII
controls.description: The organization shall retain PII only for as long as necessary to fulfill the specified purposes.

controls.title: Accuracy of PII
controls.description: The organization shall ensure that PII is accurate and kept up to date.

controls.title: Security of PII
controls.description: The organization shall implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect PII.

controls.title: Breach notification
controls.description: The organization shall have procedures for detecting, reporting and investigating PII breaches and for notifying relevant parties.

controls.title: Privacy information for PII principals
controls.description: The organization shall provide PII principals with information about the processing of their PII.

controls.title: Privacy policy
controls.description: The organization shall maintain and make available a privacy policy that describes its PII processing practices.

controls.title: Access requests
controls.description: The organization shall have procedures for responding to requests from PII principals to access their PII.

controls.title: Correction and erasure requests
controls.description: The organization shall have procedures for responding to requests from PII principals to correct or erase their PII.

controls.title: Data portability
controls.description: The organization shall have procedures for providing PII to PII principals in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format.

controls.title: Records of processing activities
controls.description: The organization shall maintain records of processing activities containing the information required by applicable privacy requirements.

controls.title: Privacy impact assessment
controls.description: The organization shall conduct privacy impact assessments when required by applicable privacy requirements or when processing is likely to result in high risk to PII principals.

controls.title: Privacy roles and responsibilities
controls.description: The organization shall assign privacy roles and responsibilities and ensure that personnel with privacy responsibilities are competent.

controls.title: Data protection officer
controls.description: The organization shall appoint a data protection officer when required by applicable privacy requirements.

controls.title: Confidentiality
controls.description: The organization shall ensure that PII is kept confidential in accordance with applicable privacy requirements.

controls.title: Contracts with PII processors
controls.description: The organization shall ensure that contracts with PII processors include the privacy requirements specified in applicable privacy requirements.

controls.title: Processing by a PII processor
controls.description: The organization shall ensure that PII processors process PII only in accordance with the organization's instructions.

controls.title: Transfers of PII to third parties
controls.description: The organization shall ensure that transfers of PII to third parties comply with applicable privacy requirements.

controls.title: Collection of PII
controls.description: The PII processor shall collect only the PII that is necessary for the specified purposes.

controls.title: Processing of PII
controls.description: The PII processor shall process PII only in accordance with the PII controller's instructions.

controls.title: Retention of PII
controls.description: The PII processor shall retain PII only for as long as necessary to fulfill the specified purposes.

controls.title: Security of PII
controls.description: The PII processor shall implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect PII.

controls.title: Breach notification
controls.description: The PII processor shall have procedures for detecting, reporting and investigating PII breaches and for notifying the PII controller.

controls.title: Confidentiality
controls.description: The PII processor shall ensure that PII is kept confidential in accordance with applicable privacy requirements.

controls.title: Privacy by design and by default
controls.description: The organization shall implement privacy by design and by default principles in the development of products and services.

controls.title: Privacy in the development lifecycle
controls.description: The organization shall integrate privacy considerations into the development lifecycle of products and services.

controls.title: Objection to processing
controls.description: The organization shall have procedures for responding to objections from PII principals to the processing of their PII.

controls.title: Restriction of processing
controls.description: The organization shall have procedures for restricting the processing of PII when requested by PII principals.

controls.title: Disclosure of PII to third parties
controls.description: The organization shall maintain records of disclosures of PII to third parties.

controls.title: Privacy awareness and training
controls.description: The organization shall provide privacy awareness and training to personnel with responsibilities for processing PII.

controls.title: Selection of PII processors
controls.description: The organization shall select PII processors that provide sufficient guarantees to implement appropriate technical and organizational measures.

controls.title: Monitoring of PII processors
controls.description: The organization shall monitor PII processors to ensure they comply with the organization's instructions and applicable privacy requirements.

controls.title: Safeguards for transfers
controls.description: The organization shall implement appropriate safeguards for transfers of PII to third parties, including transfers to third countries.

controls.title: Assistance to PII controller
controls.description: The PII processor shall assist the PII controller in responding to requests from PII principals.

controls.title: Security incident management
controls.description: The PII processor shall have procedures for managing security incidents that may affect PII.

controls.title: Privacy requirements in product and service development
controls.description: The organization shall identify and document privacy requirements during the development of products and services.

controls.title: Privacy testing
controls.description: The organization shall test privacy controls during the development of products and services.
